r: These are amazing. My 7yo son and friends play this non stop at parks and our backyard. I thought they’d get bored with it but they continue to pull it out and occupy them for hours!

Young kids and adults that are kids at heart will love this. Quick and easy to set up.

Only issues is starting a new game is annoying as it is easier to just turn it off and turn it back on reset it up each time. Would be nice if there was just a reset button or a round button or something so you don't need to do the initial setup every time. Also if the guns and the vest were paired better. But small things.

My nephews and son were entertained for hours and at any family event it's a hit
